div.div: 5 تبغّض He manifested, or showed, hatred; or he became, or made himself, an object of hatred; contr. of تَحَبَّبَ. (K.) You say, تَحَبَّبَ لِى فُلَانٌ وَ تَبَغَّضَ لِى أَخُوهُ [Such a one manifested love to me, or made himself an object of love to me, and his brother manifested hatred to me, or made himself an object of hatred to me]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
